project.mission: Provide predictable component initialization, stepping, fault handling, and shutdown without requiring a full RTOS.

explicit_non_goals: Does not provide an interrupt scheduler
Does not provide MMIO or device drivers
Caller owns serialization across independent execution contexts

safety_boundaries: Preserve explicit lifecycle transitions and reject invalid/reentrant operations.
Keep heap allocation and hidden global ownership out of the runtime contract.
Propagate callback failures and preserve deterministic fault/shutdown semantics.
Scheduling, priorities, deadlines, and watchdog integration remain external responsibilities.

native_validation.evidence_note: Host tests validate runtime contracts on the host; target-specific timing and interrupt claims need target evidence.
